starter-full-v1:starter_heavy_guard_01:t.name: Ржавая булава

omitted_slots.outer_garment: Weather-only base/pool; no current combat contribution.

build_notes.quality: Bounded middling roll search, quality 0.30..0.70; fixed seed per base and slot.
build_notes.progression: Equipment only; native skills, attributes and symbiote retained, including item-sync effects.

limitations: Physical melee reference only; not an enemy-independent strength estimate.
extra_ehp is a linear prevention scoring proxy based on armored EHP, not reciprocal expected EHP. Nested parts are included once in their aggregate.
Defense conditional on an accurate incoming hit; no attacker miss credit. Reference target has no parry/block.

Base offense retains own accuracy without target dodge discount; anti-dodge receives a separate linear suppression proxy on ordinary strikes, weighted once as extra offense. No crit/counter compounding.
No live tunable overrides, integer damage rounding or minimum-one damage floor.
Unmodeled magic, unarmed efficiency, ranged positioning, proc extra attacks, DOT/control, feints, resource exhaustion and arbitrary item triggers.

Passive counters use explicit accurate incoming melee opportunities; first response plus deterministic dual offhand only. Recursive reactions, deaths before followup and shield-opening benefit are excluded.
Only heavy-crit and dual-cross-cut crit amplification modeled; no separate skill score.
Support is the uncalibrated sum of per-round resource regeneration; no healing double count.
Weights are provisional; production GS and selection are unchanged.

starter-full-v1:starter_heavy_guard_01:t.description: Легкая рубаха пропускает воздух и защищает кожу от жары и пыли.

starter-full-v1:starter_heavy_guard_01:t.name: Кристальные меховые штаны
starter-full-v1:starter_heavy_guard_01:t.description: Меховые штаны защищают ноги от холода и долгого сидения на камне.

starter-full-v1:starter_heavy_guard_01:t.name: Кристальные дорожные ботинки
starter-full-v1:starter_heavy_guard_01:t.description: Прочные ботинки для камня, грязи и долгого пути после выхода из Рифта.

starter-full-v1:starter_heavy_guard_01:t.name: Кристальный пояс
starter-full-v1:starter_heavy_guard_01:t.description: Пояс держит снаряжение под рукой и помогает распределить вес на ходу.

starter-full-v1:starter_heavy_guard_01:t.name: Ториевый шлем
starter-full-v1:starter_heavy_guard_01:t.description: Тяжелый шлем закрывает голову от скользящих ударов и помогает удержать контроль под давлением.

starter-full-v1:starter_heavy_guard_01:t.name: Ториевые латные рукавицы
starter-full-v1:starter_heavy_guard_01:t.description: Жесткие рукавицы защищают кисти и превращают плотную оборону в болезненный контакт.

starter-full-v1:starter_heavy_guard_01:t.name: Ториевые поножи
starter-full-v1:starter_heavy_guard_01:t.description: Тяжелые поножи прикрывают ноги и помогают удержать стойку после жесткого попадания.

starter-full-v1:starter_heavy_guard_01:t.name: Призрачные рабочие перчатки
starter-full-v1:starter_heavy_guard_01:t.description: Плотные перчатки для грубой работы, хватов и защиты ладоней.

starter-full-v1:starter_heavy_guard_01:t.name: Ториевое кольцо
starter-full-v1:starter_heavy_guard_01:t.description: Простое кольцо как основа для печати, символа или вложенной силы.

starter-full-v1:starter_heavy_guard_01:t.name: Ториевый амулет

starter-full-v1:starter_heavy_guard_01:t.name: Ториевая серьга

omitted_slots.outer_garment: Weather-only base/pool; no current combat contribution.

build_notes.quality: Bounded middling roll search, quality 0.30..0.70; fixed seed per base and slot.
build_notes.progression: Equipment only; native skills, attributes and symbiote retained, including item-sync effects.

limitations: Physical melee reference only; not an enemy-independent strength estimate.
extra_ehp is a linear prevention scoring proxy based on armored EHP, not reciprocal expected EHP. Nested parts are included once in their aggregate.
Defense conditional on an accurate incoming hit; no attacker miss credit. Reference target has no parry/block.

Base offense retains own accuracy without target dodge discount; anti-dodge receives a separate linear suppression proxy on ordinary strikes, weighted once as extra offense. No crit/counter compounding.
No live tunable overrides, integer damage rounding or minimum-one damage floor.
Unmodeled magic, unarmed efficiency, ranged positioning, proc extra attacks, DOT/control, feints, resource exhaustion and arbitrary item triggers.

Passive counters use explicit accurate incoming melee opportunities; first response plus deterministic dual offhand only. Recursive reactions, deaths before followup and shield-opening benefit are excluded.
Only heavy-crit and dual-cross-cut crit amplification modeled; no separate skill score.
Support is the uncalibrated sum of per-round resource regeneration; no healing double count.
Weights are provisional; production GS and selection are unchanged.
